nodes.title: Does either party intend to complete a Section 1031 exchange?

details.whyWeAsk: Texas has a 1031 addendum; federal tax rules generally require investment/business real property, not property held primarily for sale.
details.beginnerHelp: A 1031 exchange defers tax when you swap one investment property for another. It does not work on property you bought primarily to resell, which is exactly what a flip or a wholesale assignment is. Buying, renovating and selling within a few months is treated as inventory, not investment, no matter how the paperwork is titled. Only a CPA or qualified intermediary can tell you which side of that line you are on, and they need to be involved before you close, not after.

nodes.title: What is the posted foreclosure sale date?

details.whyWeAsk: Texas foreclosure sales happen on the first Tuesday of the month after a 21-day notice. If your closing lands after the sale date, there is nothing to buy.
details.beginnerHelp: The date is on the notice of sale posted at the county courthouse and filed with the county clerk. Do not use the date the seller remembers. Work backwards from this date to decide whether any route is actually executable.
